---

### Finding movement start

###### Get vector velocity

```{R}
hand_cols <- grep("hand_[xyz]", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

# get row-to-row position shifts
dt[,
  (paste0("delta_", hand_cols)) :=
    lapply(
      .SD,
      \(col) col - shift(col, n = 1, type = "lag")
    ),
  .SDcols = hand_cols
]

dt[,
  velocity := sqrt(rowSums(.SD^2)),
  .SDcols = paste0("delta_", hand_cols)
]

dt[, mm_per_sec := velocity / (1 / 120)]
```

###### Find movement start

```{R}
trial <- get_trial(dt, 51, 5, 2)

summary(trial$mm_per_sec)

pclih(trial$mm_per_sec, braille = FALSE)

pclil(trial$mm_per_sec, trial$frame, braille = TRUE)

p <- ggplot(trial, aes(x = frame, y = mm_per_sec)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Velocity over time",
    x = "Frame",
    y = "mm/s"
  )
```
